title: Double Decker Hop-On Hop-Off City Sightseeing Philadelphia (1, 2, or 3-Day)
includes: A boarding pass is required to board the bus. Mobile voucher is not valid to board the bus.
1, 2, or 3-Day Philadelphia Hop-On Hop-Off Sightseeing Tour
Travelers must start at Stop 1 to redeem voucher for boarding pass.
Transportation aboard London-style Double Decker Bus
Professional Local Guides offer Live Commentary throughout a 1.5-Hour loop to 26 stops
Pass by 100+ Philadelphia Attractions including Liberty Bell, Independence Hall, and the US Mint
Multi-Lingual Audio Guides Available in English, French, German, Spanish, and Mandarin
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

To receive printed physical tickets, guests must redeem their online vouchers exclusively at Stop #1 or Stop #5 with a sales agent. These physical tickets are mandatory for hopping on and off the buses throughout the day.

All guests must start at Stop 1 (21 S 5th Street) or Stop 5 (12 N 12th Street) for the bus tour. At these stops, you can redeem your online voucher or purchase tickets from a sales agent. You cannot board the bus at any stop without first seeing a sales agent to do one of these, but once you get your validated paper ticket and start at stop 1 or 5, you can get on and off as you please from then on. The exception is if you purchased tickets from the visitor center and already received your paper ticket; you may start at any stop.
policies: ** You must redeem your voucher at Stop #1 or Stop # 5 to start your tour

Complimentary shuttle service is available for guests staying at Center City or Old City hotels to help you reach a sales agent and redeem your voucher. Please note that service is provided on a first-come, first-served basis and is not guaranteed. Reservations are required by phone, with the final pickup or drop-off scheduled for 3:00 PM. 215-922-2300 ( 8:30 AM - 3:00 PM )
Tickets are valid based on calendar dates and are available for 1, 2, or 3-Day options.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Beginning at the Bourse Building right across from Independence Hall and the Liberty Bell, plug into our multi-lingual headphone audio to discover the origins of America, where America’s Founding Fathers declared independence from England. Along the way, enjoy stunning views of such historic landmarks including the Christ Church Burial Grounds, Elfreth’s Alley, the Betsy Ross House, and Independence Hall.

As you head west, see the Friendship Gate in Chinatown, be amazed by the architecture of Philadelphia’s City Hall, and be sure to explore the various museums along Benjamin Franklin Parkway, including the Barnes Foundation – known as the world’s largest collection of post-impressionistic art in the world. Your loop finishes up after touring through the charming neighborhood of Society Hill and a drive along the banks of the Delaware River.
